reviewer: Claude Code (Opus 5.5) with a fresh-context medium reviewer subagent

claims.summary: Axiom repetition syzygy: for every refutation pi meeting thm:used-node-jet-erasure's hypotheses, logical axioms A->A of any formula allowed, and every t>=1, under that theorem's compiler and translation convention (tags translate to one), with pi^in (pi, used inputs first) using the same input order, literal order and placeholder labels, D = C_Lambda - C_(pi^in) (C_Lambda = H+Q, the remainder plus the input sum, from lem:remainder-identity) is a placeholder-linear zero-certificate: D(x,0)=0 and D(x,G)=0, a two-sided syzygy of the generators, equal to lem:remainder-identity's explicit repetition sum, with a formula of size O((S+t+1)^48). Hence C_pihat - A_t - P^t(C_(pi^in) - H) = P^t D, a zero-certificate in P^t F2<x,Y> of that size. The zero-certificate property and explicit form are citations of lem:matched-jet-envelope and lem:remainder-identity; the size bound is new. A property tolerant of every zero-certificate of polynomial size is constant on all certificates of polynomial size, so the corollary gives such a property nothing; exact membership of C_Lambda in the compiled-image class is not decided.
claims.assessment: Working elementary corollary, passed by the sole fresh-context medium reviewer with corrections: the zero-certificate property is the difference of two certificates of one tuple (H+Q by lem:matched-jet-envelope, C_(pi^in) by thm:shallow-noncommutative-sequent-simulation); the explicit form and the P^t location are citations; the size bound deletes the leading prefix factors syntactically from the old-portion terms of C_pihat. Exactly as conditional as thm:used-node-jet-erasure on its translation convention.
claims.rationale: Answers the approximator product review's question in its own form for logical axioms of every formula, without the atomic reduction, and records that the answer gives syzygy-tolerant properties nothing: for properties tolerant of every polynomial-size zero-certificate, the item's jet-erasure direction is a restatement of the full IPS lower bound.
claims.next_action: Decide exact membership of C_Lambda in the compiled-image class only if a property intolerant of small zero-certificates is proposed; develop the item's sub-idea, quotients of three affine products by a growing power of z^2+z.
